item.title: Can You Take My Parcel?
item.prompt_text: A parcel is coming to your flat on Friday, but you are at work all day. Write a short note to your neighbour, Mrs Karimova, in flat 12. Ask her to take the parcel for you.
item.target_grammar: Can you…? for requests; present simple
item.target_structure: hello + who I am + problem + request + thanks

checklist.point: Say hello and who you are (your name and flat)
Say when you are not at home
Ask her to take the parcel
Say thank you and when you can get it
